quotes.R2: within 4 working hours of a claim in the urgent band
quotes.R4: within 1 working day of a claim in the urgent band

what: The time allowed to make first contact on an urgent claim is 4 working hours in R2 and 1 working day in R4.
why_it_stands: Both requirements cover the same event, first contact on an urgent claim. No reading makes 4 working hours and 1 working day the same limit.
impact: Handlers and the service report will work to different deadlines, so the same call counts as on time and late.

quotes.R5: The team leader shall approve any move of a claim out of the urgent band
quotes.R6: move a claim out of the urgent band automatically

what: R5 wants a team leader to approve every move out of the urgent band and R6 makes some of those moves with nobody approving.
why_it_stands: Looked for an exception in R5 for automatic moves. R5 says any move.
impact: Either the automatic move is built and R5 is broken, or it waits for approval and R6 saves no time.

what: The person to contact is the customer in R2 and the policyholder in R4.
why_it_stands: The two words may or may not mean the same person. Nothing in the requirements says.
open_question: On a motor claim, are the customer and the policyholder always the same person?

quotes.R1: assign every new motor claim a triage band
quotes.R7: assign a fraud score to every new motor claim

what: Both give every new motor claim a rating, so one looked like a repeat of the other.
reason: A triage band says how fast to act and a fraud score says how closely to look. They are two different ratings.
